pages.title: How Effects Work
pages.text: Your nutrient bars directly affect your character.$(br2)$(c:#e05252)Let them fall too low — debuffs kick in.$()$(br2)$(c:#52c252)Keep them high — passive bonuses kick in.$()$(br2)Effects are checked every second and applied automatically. No potions. No crafting. Your diet does the work.

pages.title: Penalties
pages.text: When a nutrient drops $(bold)below 25%$():$(br2)$(li)$(c:#ff6b6b)$(bold)Fruits$()$() → Unluck I$(li)$(c:#6bff6b)$(bold)Vegetables$()$() → Slowness I$(li)$(c:#ff9f6b)$(bold)Proteins$()$() → Mining Fatigue I$(li)$(c:#ffef6b)$(bold)Grains$()$() → Weakness I$(br2)$(italic)Sugars and Dairy have no individual penalty — but neglecting them costs you the balance bonus.$()

pages.title: The Balance Bonus
pages.text: When $(bold)all six groups are above 75%$(), you earn:$(br2)$(c:#52c252)$(li)Health Boost I$(li)Regeneration I$()$(br2)Both effects persist as long as every bar stays above the threshold. Let $(italic)one$() slip and they both fade.$(br2)$(bold)This is the payoff.$() Build toward it.
